prerequisites.name: apt prerequisites
prerequisites.command: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl ca-certificates git xz-utils python3 python3-venv python3-pip >/dev/null

prerequisites.name: Node 22 from nodejs.org (pinned)
prerequisites.command: curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.22.3/node-v22.22.3-linux-$(uname -m | sed 's/x86_64/x64/;s/aarch64/arm64/').tar.xz -o /tmp/node.tar.xz && mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/nodejs && tar -xJf /tmp/node.tar.xz -C /usr/local/lib/nodejs --strip-components=1 && ln -sf /usr/local/lib/nodejs/bin/node /usr/local/bin/node && ln -sf /usr/local/lib/nodejs/bin/npm /usr/local/bin/npm && ln -sf /usr/local/lib/nodejs/bin/npx /usr/local/bin/npx && node --version

prerequisites.name: home
prerequisites.command: mkdir -p /home/dev && cd /home/dev && git config --global user.email dev@example.test && git config --global user.name dev
